node.statement: The primitive layer is positive and finite: sqrt(2)>1 makes C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1)>0 and finite; hence C_A=20+(211/8)*C_theta>0 and finite. Since C_E is a finite real scalar, bar_C_E=max{1,C_E} is finite and at least 1, so C_V=bar_C_E*C_A and C_T=C_theta+3*C_V are positive and finite. Also rho_theta=1/8>0, rho_AI=eta_A>0, and epsilon_E/C_A>0; the two reciprocal entries in (1.1) have positive finite denominators. Thus every entry defining rho_T is positive, so rho_T>0.
